answer.says: Ramesh, the arithmetic of my poverty is not yours to bear. I cannot pay you today, nor can I sustain the full wage. But a state that cannot feed its subjects is no state at all. If you come on Mondays, Thursdays and Saturdays, we will call it four thousand. I will find the rest.
answer.thought: The tension here is not merely financial; it is the collision of my dignity with the necessity of his labor. He offers a compromise, a reduction of the universal claim to a particular arrangement, and I must accept it to keep the household from collapsing into anarchy. I am reduced to negotiating with the very servant who keeps my life in order, a humiliation that mirrors the absurdity of my position in this city.
